```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
df <- readRDS("inputs_results.rds")
```

```{r}
k1_val          <- 2
k2_val          <- 4
p_val           <- 0.11
sigma_val       <- 0.7
```

```{r}
n_total <- 10000
n_weak_lower <- n_total * 0.2
n_weak_upper <- n_total * 0.35
```

```{r}
df_aug <- df %>%
  mutate(
    row_id       = row_number(),
    tot_weak     = map_dbl(i_w, ~ if (length(.x)) sum(.x) else 0),
    final_strong = map_dbl(n_strong, ~ if (length(.x)) .x[length(.x)] else 0),
    cond_a       = final_strong < n_total,
    cond_b       = tot_weak > n_weak_upper,
    cond_c       = tot_weak < n_weak_lower
  )
```

```{r}
r0_tmp <- df_aug %>% filter(cond_a)
rem1   <- df_aug %>% filter(!cond_a)
```

```{r}
r3_tmp <- rem1 %>% filter(cond_c)
rem2   <- rem1 %>% filter(!cond_c)
```

```{r}
r1_tmp <- rem2 %>% filter(cond_b)
r2_tmp <- rem2 %>% filter(!cond_b)
```

```{r}
drop_aux <- c("row_id","tot_weak","final_strong","cond_a","cond_b","cond_c")

r0 <- r0_tmp %>% select(-all_of(drop_aux))
r1 <- r1_tmp %>% select(-all_of(drop_aux))
r2 <- r2_tmp %>% select(-all_of(drop_aux))
r3 <- r3_tmp %>% select(-all_of(drop_aux))
```

```{r}
mk_long_weak <- function(d) {
  d %>%
    transmute(run_id,
              l = map2(weak_by_weak, weak_by_strong, ~{
                n <- length(.x)
                if (n == 0) {
                  tibble(step = integer(),
                         tau  = double(),
                         w_by_w = double(),
                         w_by_s = double())
                } else {
                  ww <- c(0, as.numeric(.x))
                  ws <- c(0, as.numeric(.y))
                  n2 <- length(ww)
                  tibble(step = seq_len(n2) - 1,
                         tau  = seq(0, 1, length.out = n2),
                         w_by_w = ww,
                         w_by_s = ws)
                }
              })) %>%
    unnest(l) %>%
    mutate(ratio = if_else(w_by_w + w_by_s > 0, w_by_s / (w_by_w + w_by_s), 0)) %>%
    select(run_id, tau, ratio)
}

mk_long_strong <- function(d) {
  d %>%
    transmute(run_id,
              l = map2(strong_by_weak, strong_by_strong, ~{
                n <- length(.x)
                if (n == 0) {
                  tibble(step = integer(),
                         tau  = double(),
                         s_by_w = double(),
                         s_by_s = double())
                } else {
                  sw <- c(0, as.numeric(.x))
                  ss <- c(0, as.numeric(.y))
                  n2 <- length(sw)
                  tibble(step = seq_len(n2) - 1,
                         tau  = seq(0, 1, length.out = n2),
                         s_by_w = sw,
                         s_by_s = ss)
                }
              })) %>%
    unnest(l) %>%
    mutate(ratio = if_else(s_by_w + s_by_s > 0, s_by_s / (s_by_w + s_by_s), 0)) %>%
    select(run_id, tau, ratio)
}
```

```{r}
select_group <- function(d, k1_val, k2_val, p_val, sigma_val) {
  d %>%
    filter(k1 == k1_val, k2 == k2_val, dplyr::near(p, p_val), dplyr::near(sigma, sigma_val)) %>%
    mutate(run_id = row_number())
}

mk_long_weak <- function(d) {
  d %>%
    transmute(run_id,
              l = map2(weak_by_weak, weak_by_strong, ~ tibble(step = seq_along(.x),
                                                               w_by_w = as.numeric(.x),
                                                               w_by_s = as.numeric(.y)))) %>%
    unnest(l) %>%
    mutate(ratio = if_else(w_by_w + w_by_s > 0, w_by_s/(w_by_w + w_by_s), NA_real_)) %>%
    select(run_id, step, ratio)
}

mk_long_strong <- function(d) {
  d %>%
    transmute(run_id,
              l = map2(strong_by_weak, strong_by_strong, ~ tibble(step = seq_along(.x),
                                                                   s_by_w = as.numeric(.x),
                                                                   s_by_s = as.numeric(.y)))) %>%
    unnest(l) %>%
    mutate(ratio = if_else(s_by_w + s_by_s > 0, s_by_s/(s_by_w + s_by_s), NA_real_)) %>%
    select(run_id, step, ratio)
}
```

```{r}
r1_g <- select_group(r1, k1_val, k2_val, p_val, sigma_val)
r2_g <- select_group(r2, k1_val, k2_val, p_val, sigma_val)
r3_g <- select_group(r3, k1_val, k2_val, p_val, sigma_val)

W1 <- if (nrow(r1_g)) mk_long_weak(r1_g) else tibble(run_id=integer(), tau=double(), ratio=double())
W2 <- if (nrow(r2_g)) mk_long_weak(r2_g) else tibble(run_id=integer(), tau=double(), ratio=double())
W3 <- if (nrow(r3_g)) mk_long_weak(r3_g) else tibble(run_id=integer(), tau=double(), ratio=double())

S1 <- if (nrow(r1_g)) mk_long_strong(r1_g) else tibble(run_id=integer(), tau=double(), ratio=double())
S2 <- if (nrow(r2_g)) mk_long_strong(r2_g) else tibble(run_id=integer(), tau=double(), ratio=double())
S3 <- if (nrow(r3_g)) mk_long_strong(r3_g) else tibble(run_id=integer(), tau=double(), ratio=double())
```

```{r}
combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(

  dplyr::mutate(r2, regime = "r2"),
```

```{r}
# Find the maximum step length across all weak/strong runs
max_step_weak <- combined %>%
  mutate(len = map_int(weak_by_weak, length)) %>%
  summarise(max_len = max(len, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(max_len)

max_step_strong <- combined %>%
  mutate(len = map_int(strong_by_weak, length)) %>%
  summarise(max_len = max(len, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(max_len)

# Pad weak runs
weak_long_padded <- combined %>%
  transmute(regime, sigma, run_id,
            l = map2(weak_by_weak, weak_by_strong, ~{
              n <- length(.x)
              ww <- as.numeric(.x)
              ws <- as.numeric(.y)
              tib <- tibble(step = seq_len(n),
                            w_by_w = ww,
                            w_by_s = ws)
              tib <- tib %>%
                mutate(ratio = if_else(w_by_w + w_by_s > 0, w_by_s / (w_by_w + w_by_s), 0))
              if (n < max_step_weak) {
                tib <- bind_rows(
                  tib,
                  tibble(step = (n+1):max_step_weak,
                         w_by_w = NA_real_, w_by_s = NA_real_, ratio = 1)
                )
              }
              tib
            })) %>%
  unnest(l) %>%
  select(regime, sigma, run_id, step, ratio)

# Pad strong runs

  transmute(regime, sigma, run_id,
            l = map2(strong_by_weak, strong_by_strong, ~{

              tib <- tibble(step = seq_len(n),

              tib <- tib %>%
                mutate(ratio = if_else(s_by_w + s_by_s > 0, s_by_s / (s_by_w + s_by_s), 0))
              if (n < max_step_strong) {
                tib <- bind_rows(
                  tib,

            })) %>%
  unnest(l) %>%
```

```{r}
# Variable threshold for alignment
threshold <- 0.9

align_runs <- function(df, threshold) {
  df %>%
    group_by(regime, sigma, run_id) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      d <- .x
      # find first step where ratio >= threshold
      hit <- which(d$ratio >= threshold)[1]
      if (is.na(hit)) {
        align_offset <- 0
      } else {
        align_offset <- d$step[hit]
      }
      d %>% mutate(align_step = step - align_offset)
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# Align weak and strong runs using the correct data frames
weak_aligned <- align_runs(weak_long_padded, threshold)
strong_aligned <- align_runs(strong_long_padded, threshold)

# Find global min/max across all runs
min_shift <- min(c(weak_aligned$align_step, strong_aligned$align_step), na.rm=TRUE)
max_shift <- max(c(weak_aligned$align_step, strong_aligned$align_step), na.rm=TRUE)

# Pad each run to cover full range with 0 at start and 1 at end
pad_aligned <- function(df, min_shift, max_shift) {
  df %>%
    group_by(regime, sigma, run_id) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      d <- .x
      # full range
      full_steps <- seq(min_shift, max_shift)
      d2 <- tibble(align_step = full_steps) %>%
        left_join(d, by="align_step")
      # fill start and end padding
      d2$ratio[is.na(d2$ratio) & d2$align_step < min(d$align_step)] <- 0
      d2$ratio[is.na(d2$ratio) & d2$align_step > max(d$align_step)] <- 1
      d2$regime <- unique(d$regime)
      d2$sigma <- unique(d$sigma)
      d2$run_id <- unique(d$run_id)
      d2
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
}

weak_aligned_pad <- pad_aligned(weak_aligned, min_shift, max_shift)
strong_aligned_pad <- pad_aligned(strong_aligned, min_shift, max_shift)

# ADDED: Create the summary data frames needed for the plots below
weak_aligned_summary <- weak_aligned_pad %>%
  group_by(sigma, align_step) %>%
  summarise(
    med = median(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

strong_aligned_summary <- strong_aligned_pad %>%
  group_by(sigma, align_step) %>%
  summarise(
    med = median(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Plots
g_weak_all_threshold <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = weak_aligned_pad,
            aes(align_step, ratio, group = interaction(regime, run_id), color = sigma),
            alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_ribbon(data = weak_aligned_summary,
              aes(align_step, ymin = pmax(0, med - sd), ymax = pmin(1, med + sd),
                  group = sigma, fill = factor(sigma)), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(data = weak_aligned_summary,
            aes(align_step, med, color = sigma, group = sigma), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = expression(sigma)) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = expression(sigma)) +
  labs(title = paste("Weak ratio (aligned at threshold =", threshold, ")", title_suffix),
       x = "aligned step (0 = threshold crossing)",
       y = "weak_by_strong / (weak_by_weak + weak_by_strong)") +
  theme_minimal()

g_strong_all_threshold <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = strong_aligned_pad,
            aes(align_step, ratio, group = interaction(regime, run_id), color = sigma),
            alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_ribbon(data = strong_aligned_summary,
              aes(align_step, ymin = pmax(0, med - sd), ymax = pmin(1, med + sd),
                  group = sigma, fill = factor(sigma)), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(data = strong_aligned_summary,
            aes(align_step, med, color = sigma, group = sigma), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = expression(sigma)) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = expression(sigma)) +
  labs(title = paste("Strong ratio (aligned at threshold =", threshold, ")", title_suffix),
       x = "aligned step (0 = threshold crossing)",
       y = "strong_by_strong / (strong_by_weak + strong_by_strong)") +
  theme_minimal()

print(g_weak_all_threshold)
print(g_strong_all_threshold)
```

```{r}
# Division-based normalization (step/max_step per run)
normalize_division <- function(df, start_val = 0, end_val = 1, n_points = 200) {
  df %>%
    group_by(regime, sigma, run_id) %>%
    mutate(max_step = max(step)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(regime, sigma, run_id) %>%
    do({
      run <- .
      norm_step <- run$step / run$max_step
      ratio <- run$ratio
      # common grid across runs (0 → 1)
      grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = n_points)
      interp <- approx(norm_step, ratio, xout = grid, rule = 2, ties = "ordered")$y
      tibble(norm_step = grid,
             ratio = interp)
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(ratio = ifelse(norm_step == 0, start_val, ratio),
           ratio = ifelse(norm_step == 1, end_val, ratio))
}

# Apply to weak and strong runs using the correct data frames
weak_div <- normalize_division(weak_long_padded)
strong_div <- normalize_division(strong_long_padded)

# Summaries for median ± sd per sigma
weak_div_summary <- weak_div %>%
  group_by(sigma, norm_step) %>%
  summarise(med = median(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd  = sd(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

strong_div_summary <- strong_div %>%
  group_by(sigma, norm_step) %>%
  summarise(med = median(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd  = sd(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# Weak division-normalized plot
g_weak_all_division <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = weak_div_summary,
              aes(norm_step,
                  ymin = pmax(0, med - sd),
                  ymax = pmin(1, med + sd),
                  group = sigma,
                  fill = factor(sigma)),
              alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(data = weak_div_summary,
            aes(norm_step, med, color = sigma, group = sigma),
            linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = expression(sigma)) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = expression(sigma)) +
  labs(title = paste("Weak ratio (division normalized, median ±1 sd): r1 + r2 + r3  ", title_suffix),
       x = "normalized step (step / max step)",
       y = "weak_by_strong / (weak_by_weak + weak_by_strong)") +
  theme_minimal()

# Strong division-normalized plot
g_strong_all_division <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = strong_div_summary,
              aes(norm_step,
                  ymin = pmax(0, med - sd),
                  ymax = pmin(1, med + sd),
                  group = sigma,
                  fill = factor(sigma)),
              alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(data = strong_div_summary,
            aes(norm_step, med, color = sigma, group = sigma),
            linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = expression(sigma)) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = expression(sigma)) +
  labs(title = paste("", title_suffix),
       x = "normalized step (step / max step)",
       y = "strong_by_strong / (strong_by_weak + strong_by_strong)") +
  theme_minimal()

print(g_weak_all_division)
print(g_strong_all_division)
```

```{r}
# Step 1: Determine majority regime per sigma
sigma_regime_map <- combined %>%
  group_by(sigma, regime) %>%
  summarise(n_runs = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(sigma) %>%
  slice_max(n_runs, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(sigma, regime_majority = regime)

# Step 2: Merge with summary data
strong_div_summary_regime <- strong_div_summary %>%
  left_join(sigma_regime_map, by = "sigma")

# Step 3: Modified plot
g_strong_all_division_regime <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = strong_div_summary_regime,
              aes(norm_step,
                  ymin = pmax(0, med - sd),
                  ymax = pmin(1, med + sd),
                  group = sigma,
                  fill = sigma),
              alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(data = strong_div_summary_regime,
            aes(norm_step, med, color = sigma, group = sigma),
            size = 1) +
  # add points with shapes = regime majority
  geom_point(data = strong_div_summary_regime,
             aes(norm_step, med, color = sigma, shape = regime_majority),
             size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = expression(sigma)) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = expression(sigma)) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Majority Regime",
                     values = c(r1 = 16, r2 = 17, r3 = 15)) + # circle, triangle, square
  labs(title = paste("median ±1 sd", title_suffix),
       x = "normalized step (step / max step)",
       y = "strong_by_strong / (strong_by_weak + strong_by_strong)") +
  theme_minimal()

print(g_strong_all_division_regime)

```
